observation_authority: RGB-D, calibrated FK, measured map, actuator feedback; no scene truth
bootstrap_scope: Recorded measured-action imitation only; separate from online PPO and formal evaluation
success_unit: All objects placed and withdrawn with independent geometry, capture, placement and timing audits
confidence_interval: Report Wilson 95%; 990/1000 is a point estimate, not proof that population success is >=99%

randomization.placement: bounded noninterpenetrating placement; no IK, visibility, or success admission
randomization.size_position_separation: Must freeze numerical workspace/size bounds after simulator integration and before independent evaluation
randomization.physical_support: Validate generated poses against table support; unsupported samples must not silently become successes

interface_prior: Known magnetic interface and requested destination; object count/extent/pose not supplied to policy
initial_map: Only authenticated RGB-D; initial scan budget is part of evaluation and must be frozen

candidate_policy.encoder: RGB-D small CNN + measured map features + GRU
candidate_policy.proprioception: sin(q), cos(q), measured joint velocity, previous executed increment, history
candidate_policy.safety: whole-path self/inter-arm/environment/payload guard; rejection must not accumulate unexecuted commands
candidate_policy.training: fresh initialization, supervised bootstrap optional, recurrent PPO online

parallelism: Benchmark 1/4/16 real RGB-D environments before selecting count; do not assume proprioceptive-RL throughput
promotion: No promotion from unit tests, proxy rewards, offline IK, or partial object success
status_notes: Environment, actor observation adapter, PPO runner, and full-task evaluation still require integration
